description: This file defines the FirstScreen widget, a Flutter StatefulWidget representing the initial screen for new users. It requests location and phone permissions, displays informational UI elements with icons and texts, and navigates to SecondScreen upon permission handling.

classes.name: FirstScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the app's initial screen, prompting for permissions.

classes.name: _FirstScreenState
classes.description: State class managing UI, permission requests, and navigation logic for FirstScreen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the FirstScreen, including icons, texts, permission items, and button.

methods.name: _buildPermissionItem
methods.description: Creates a widget displaying an icon and explanatory text for permissions.

methods.name: _handleAllowPermissions
methods.description: Initiates location permission request and navigates to SecondScreen afterward.

methods.name: _requestPermissionsAndNavigate
methods.description: Performs permission requests, updates preferences, and navigates to the next screen.
